download_isgbench_data: download the ISG-Bench dataset from GitHub and HuggingFace into a specified data directory
load_isgbench_prompts: load ISG-Bench prompts from a JSONL file and return a dictionary mapping lookup keys to prompt data
create_isgbench_lookup_key: create a lookup key string from a prompt ID and category for ISG-Bench data retrieval
download_isgbench_force: force re-download the ISG-Bench dataset by cloning the repo and fetching fresh images from HuggingFace
review_load_prompts_extension_handling: review the load_prompts function to understand how it handles image file extension case mismatches
